text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day. The students<n>are running
around, excitedly giving<n>out chocolates as symbols
of<n>gratitude and affection.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? So this is where you've been.<n>I'm glad I found
you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. So I<n>brought a gift worthy
of the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate how hard you work for<n>my sake.
Would you accept this from<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm glad. Please, go ahead...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Which would you like to try first—the<n>sweet one or
the salty one?
Hehehe. ♪ You'll see...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How did you find the flavor?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Japanese sweets seem surprisingly<n>fitting for
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not only are they filling, but decorating<n>them with
seasonal flowers creates a<n>treat for the eyes as
well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And a hint of salt adds a layer of<n>flavor which
sweetness alone cannot<n>provide.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I always associated Valentine's Day<n>with
chocolate, but now...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Um. Was it to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Or would it have been better to stick<n>with
tried-and-true chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh—well, I'm glad to hear that!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have the time to make them<n>for anyone
else, but I at least wanted<n>to handmake something
for you...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I hope that I was able to convey my<n>gratitude. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After that, she prepares some slightly<n>bitter tea to
go with the sweets.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It may have been a bit<n>unconventional, but I got to
enjoy a<n>Japanese-y Valentine's Day with<n>Grass
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um... Did the taste not match your<n>palate, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
While I understand Japanese<n>confectioneries
aren't typically paired<n>with Valentine's Day...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give you something<n>special.
choice_data_list:
Then I'd better come up with something for you,
too!

Then I'd better come up with something for you,
too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Those words are enough<n>of a gift on
their own.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But if you truly intend on gifting me<n>something in
return, please find<n>another kind of Japanese sweet.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That way, we can put together<n>something more
elaborate and enjoy<n>it with a cup of tea.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Another time spent like this would be<n>wonderful. ♪
